Direct provider supports confirmed Local: Direct provider supports confirmed Local and managed per-project Docker. Auto prefers Docker; Local fallback requires separate confirmation and is only allowed before Docker preparation. Explicit Docker/SSH and pinned runs never downgrade. Direct supports Docker/SSH chat/tools and Kanban/AutoMode with pinned worktrees, context, tests, Verify, Commit and feature shell hooks. Managed merge is fast-forward only; no push or sync. Git UI reads, stage/unstage, commit and worktree creation use the selected target. Advanced/network/PR Git actions and project-wide hooks are not migrated. Integrated terminals use prepared Docker/SSH targets (Linux/Python 3); backend restart closes the shell rather than replaying commands. Manual tests use the same prepared Docker/SSH target and stream logs; pinned Local manual tests also use the Linux/Python 3 supervisor. Managed dev servers and HTTP/WebSocket previews use the captured target with separate authenticated preview ports; cookies, service workers and cross-origin backend requests are not supported in this preview MVP. Cursor, Gemini and OpenCode support Docker/SSH chat and Kanban via remote CLI. Install and authenticate the CLI inside that environment; server credentials are not copied. Gemini/OpenCode read-only approval planning is not supported. Claude/Codex/Copilot support Docker/SSH chat and Kanban after target SDK setup. Old Docker features without workspace metadata require a new feature; no automatic migration occurs. Direct text-only queries do not execute tools. Provider sign-in/model discovery elsewhere in Settings still describes the Automaker server, not the remote CLI installation.
